_readme: Hand corrections merged over the parsed weapons by tools/build_dataset.py.
Keyed by "Hero|Weapon name". Everything here exists because the wiki states the
value in prose a parser cannot read, not because the parser is weak.
Beams: the wiki gives damage per second and ammo drain per second, but the engine
needs damage per tick. Overwatch beams tick 20 times a second, so dpshot = dps/20,
fireRate = 20, and the magazine is restated in ticks: ammo * 20 / drainPerSecond.
'drop' removes a weapon entirely. Healing tools deal no damage and do not belong in
a damage chart; inventing a number for them would be worse than leaving them out.
Transform weapons: Bastion's Assault turret and Ramattra's Pummel state 'ammo = infinity'
on the wiki, and they do mean it - neither reloads. What ends them is the form running
out, and that duration lives on the transform ability rather than on the weapon, so the
parser cannot see it. Left alone the engine fires them forever and reports 360 dps for a
gun that is available six seconds in every thirteen. The form is therefore written down
as a magazine: ammo = rate * duration, reloadTime = cooldown - duration + cast time.
Turrets: a turret is on the chart for the same reason a gun is - it produces a stream of
damage you can compare with everything else. Symmetra's states its damage as a rate, so
it is treated as a beam: 30 dps over 20 ticks is 1.5 per tick.
'add' defines a weapon outright, for the few the wiki only describes in prose.
Venom Mine is dropped rather than treated as a turret. It is destructible and its damage
is written as a rate, which is the same signature a turret has, but the rate is poison on
whoever trips it - the mine never shoots at anything, so a firing timeline would be a lie.

Symmetra|Photon Projector._note: 60/120/180 dps by charge level. Charge time per level is not stated on the wiki; 1.33 s carried over from the owdmgchart reference dataset.

Winston|Tesla Cannon Alt Fire._note: Charged bolt: 60 damage at full charge, 37.5 dps firing continuously, so one shot every 1.6 s.

Zarya|Particle Cannon._note: 95 dps at 0 energy and 175 at 100, so damage scales by 0.842 per full charge.

Mei|Endothermic Blaster._note: 5.5 per tick at 20 ticks/s is the wiki's 110 dps; 140 rounds draining 20/s gives 7 s of fire.

Moira|Biotic Grasp Alt Fire._note: 65 dps, no magazine - the resource is her biotic energy, which this model does not track.

Anran|Fan the Flames._note: The wiki calls it a beam, but 6 damage per pellet for 36 a shot is a projectile shotgun and behaves like one. Reports 2 and 4. Against a burning target it goes from 36 a volley to 72, and lifts the burn itself from 10 a second to 20. The wiki's dps lines follow exactly: 60 while firing when the target is not alight, 140 when it is.

Domina|Photon Magnum._note: One weapon, not two: a beam that culminates in a hitscan shot, costing 10 of 100 rounds per cycle. The wiki's own damage lines (60 over time plus a 60 shot) cannot be reconciled with its stated rate - 120 per cycle would be far more than 90 dps - so the stated figures win, as everywhere else. 60 per cycle at 1.5 cycles per second gives the 90 dps it states while firing, and 73 against its stated ~72 overall with reload.

Freja|Take Aim._note: Single bolt, 0.4 s to fire and a 1.5 s reload after every shot. Only the direct hit is modelled, not the explosion.

Symmetra|Photon Projector Alt Fire._note: Report 7. The orb was recorded at full charge only: 0.8 shots/s, and a magazine of ten. The wiki gives both ends - 3.9 shots/s at minimum charge (0.256 s recovery) and 0.8 at maximum (1 s charge + 0.25 s recovery), 100 ammo draining 1 to 10 a shot - so the charge setting now drives the rate and the ammo as well as the damage. Projectile speed was 25; the wiki says 50.

Sojourn|Charged Shot._note: Report 6. It was firing every 0.64 s forever, which is her ultimate's behaviour and not hers. The 0.64 s on the wiki is the recovery after a shot, not a rate: the shot spends energy, and energy only comes from landing primary fire - 5 per body hit, 100 for a full one. Twenty hits from a 16 shot/s railgun is 1.25 s, plus the 0.64 s recovery, so 1.89 s is the fastest this can be repeated and that assumes every shot lands on a body. Damage now scales with the charge as the wiki describes it - 1 damage per point of energy above a base of 20, so 21 at one point and 120 at a hundred.

Bastion|Configuration: Assault._note: Assault lasts 6 s on a 12 s cooldown with 1 + 0.5 s of transform animation, and does not reload. 30 shots/s * 6 s = 180 rounds, then 12 - 6 + 1.5 = 7.5 s before it can fire again.

Bastion|Configuration: Assault (Lindholm._note: Damage falloff, wiki: 30 - 50 meters. The parser never read it, so the weapon was drawn doing full damage at any distance the chart shows.

Ramattra|Pummel._note: Melee reach, wiki: 10 meters. Without it the weapon dealt full damage at any distance the chart could show, which flattered every hero who fights in melee.

Symmetra|Sentry Turret._note: The wiki states 30 damage per second and no rate. Treated as a beam at the usual 20 ticks a second, so 1.5 per tick. Range is the stated 10 m of turret beam.

Torbjörn|Deploy Turret._note: 12 damage at 4 shots a second, hitscan, out to the stated 40 m attack range. It never reloads and fires until destroyed.

Brigitte|Rocket Flail._note: Melee reach, wiki: 6 meters. Without it the weapon dealt full damage at any distance the chart could show, which flattered every hero who fights in melee.

Reinhardt|Rocket Hammer._note: Melee reach, wiki: 4 meters. Without it the weapon dealt full damage at any distance the chart could show, which flattered every hero who fights in melee.

Torbjörn|Forge Hammer._note: Melee reach, wiki: 2.5 meters, same as quick melee. Without it the weapon dealt full damage at any distance the chart could show, which flattered every hero who fights in melee.

Vendetta|Palatine Fang._note: Melee reach, wiki: 4.3 meters (swing); the overhead reaches 6.8. Without it the weapon dealt full damage at any distance the chart could show, which flattered every hero who fights in melee.

Roadhog|Scrap Gun Alt Fire._note: Damage falloff, wiki: 30 - 50 meters. The parser never read it, so the weapon was drawn doing full damage at any distance the chart shows.

Jetpack Cat|Biotic Pawjectiles._note: Hard range, wiki: 40 meters. Without it the weapon reached as far as the slider goes.

Kiriko|Kunai._note: Hard range, wiki: 30 meters. Without it the weapon reached as far as the slider goes.

Mizuki|Spirit Glaive._note: Hard range, wiki: 30 meters. Without it the weapon reached as far as the slider goes.

Ramattra|Void Accelerator._note: Hard range, wiki: 35 meters. Without it the weapon reached as far as the slider goes.

Sigma|Hyperspheres._note: Hard range, wiki: 21 meters. Without it the weapon reached as far as the slider goes.

Venture|Smart Excavator._note: Hard range, wiki: 16 meters. Without it the weapon reached as far as the slider goes.

Zarya|Particle Cannon Alt Fire._note: Hard range, wiki: 15 meters. Without it the weapon reached as far as the slider goes.

Mauga|Incendiary Chaingun._note: Report 4. Gunny ignites a target after ten hits and then burns it for 15 a second over four seconds, refreshed by continued fire. The wiki's own figures check this: 4 damage at 17.36 shots/s is 69.44 dps, and it lists 84.44 with the burn.

Mauga|Volatile Chaingun._note: Report 2. Cha-Cha scores a critical hit on anything already alight, whatever it hits, which is a doubling. The wiki lists 138.88 for both guns on a non-burning target and 208.32 on a burning one.

Torbjörn|Deploy Turret (Overloaded)._note: The Overloaded Turret perk. Its missiles are only described in prose - 'a burst of 3 missiles every 1.5 seconds', 30 damage each - so no field carries the rate and the parser cannot see it. That is 60 dps of missiles on top of the turret's own 48, modelled here as one 27-damage shot at 4/s: 108 dps combined, which is what the two together produce.

Mauga|Both Chainguns._note: Report 3. Mauga is played with both barrels down, and the chart only ever showed them one at a time. Firing together is not simply twice one gun: the wiki gives a separate falloff of 15-20 metres instead of 30-40, a spread of 4 degrees instead of 1, and the 300 rounds are shared so they drain twice as fast. Burning is worth half again rather than double, because only Cha-Cha crits on a lit target - (4 + 8) / 8 = 1.5 - and Gunny's 15 a second of fire is on top. All three of the wiki's own figures come back out: 138.88 on a cold target, 208.32 on a burning one, 223.32 with the burn counted.

Junker Queen|Quick Melee (blade in hand)._note: Report 12. Her melee is two different attacks and the dataset recorded one. With the blade in hand it wounds for 15 over three seconds on top of the swing; the wiki is explicit that 'melee attacks while the blade is thrown do not apply a wound'. Swinging again refreshes the wound rather than stacking it, so at a swing a second the wound contributes its full 15 each time. 55 a swing is the honest figure for the state this row is named after.

Jetpack Cat|Quick Melee (Claws Out)._note: Report 12. The Claws Out perk makes one melee in every six seconds an empowered one, wounding for 40 on top of the 40 swing. It is a separate row rather than a change to her melee because it is not every swing: the rate here is the rate the empowered swing actually comes round at, which is what makes the number comparable to anything else on the chart. Ordinary swings in between are the Quick Melee row.

Symmetra|Photon Projector (Perfect Align._note: Report 5. 'Increase the range of Photon Projector's primary fire by 20%' - a change to a number that applies whenever the perk is taken, with no condition attached, so it is one of the ones worth drawing. 12 metres becomes 14.4.

Domina|Photon Magnum (Extended Power)._note: Report 5. 'Increase the range of Photon Magnum by 20%'. 25 metres becomes 30.

Roadhog|Scrap Gun Alt Fire (Shrapnel Lau._note: Report 5. 'Extend the range of Scrap Gun's secondary fire by 50% and tighten its burst spread by 25%'. Both apply unconditionally: the falloff window moves from 30-50 metres to 45-75, and the spread cone loses a quarter of its angle.

Junkrat|Frag Launcher (Frag Cannon)._note: Report 5. 'Frag Launcher's projectile speed is increased by 25%'. 30 m/s becomes 37.5, which shortens the lead a moving target needs rather than changing the damage.

Widowmaker|Widow's Kiss (ADS) (Scoped Ef._note: Report 5. 'Scoped shots cost 3 ammo instead of 5'. The magazine holds 35 rounds, so a scoped Widowmaker goes from 7 shots between reloads to 11 - the damage is untouched and the reload is amortised over half again as many shots.
